title: 1811 Prairie's north pier capped below the bay, sky above it
items: The narrow stone pier at the front's north end now stops below the bay's cornice. It has a moulded cap, a band under the cap, and a small slate top, as in the 1888 plate and the photographs.
The main roof's eave no longer runs out over the pier, so there is sky above the cap.
The pier is rock-faced all the way up. The pale string course no longer crosses it.
A downpipe now runs down the corner where the pier meets the bay.
